beats.say: Touching a toad... will *not* give you warts.
Rudi doesn't believe that. He finds one in his garden... and *panics.*
So Rudi grabs *oven mitts* to carry it out. It hops straight into his *boot.*
The mitts didn't work, so Rudi digs a *moat* around the house. Toads love *water.*
Here's the truth: warts come from a human *virus.* Toads don't carry it.
The big ones behind the eyes ooze *poison.* Dogs that bite a toad start to *foam.*
The Burke Museum says it plainly: no amphibian gives you *warts.*
And one toad can eat up to *ten thousand* bugs in a summer.
So Rudi's moat? It's now a toad *pool party.*
Leave toads be. Wash your hands if you touch one, and keep your *dog* away.
So the next time Rudi spots a toad... remember:
